about.s: I build the systems a company runs on: attendance, overtime, payroll.
about.p1: I'm one of three developers on the HR system that 13 Panasonic group companies use. I own delivery for six of them: requirements, estimates, development and installation on their servers. I also train users at every rollout, prepare SOX audit documents and mentor interns.
about.p2: Before code I edited video. I studied informatics at IPB and Telkom University, and I'm now doing a Master of Management in HR, with a thesis on presenteeism, work-life balance and burnout.
education: Master of Management, HR, Universitas Pancasila, expected 2027

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.intro: This site keeps things simple: no accounts, no contact forms, and no analytics unless you allow them.
privacy.collectBody: If you click Accept on the cookie banner, Google Analytics 4 records anonymous usage data: which pages are viewed, the rough region and device type, and clicks on the email buttons, the CV download, project links, opened case rows and the theme switch. It does not tell me who you are. If you click Reject or ignore the banner, Google Analytics does not run and sets no cookies.

cookies.name: lang_pref
cookies.purpose: Remembers your language choice (English or Indonesian).

cookies.name: consent
cookies.purpose: Remembers whether you accepted or rejected analytics.

cookies.name: _ga, _ga_*
cookies.purpose: Google Analytics, set only after you click Accept.

cookies.name: rr-theme
cookies.purpose: Local storage. Remembers light or dark mode. It stays in your browser and is never sent anywhere.

cookies.name: rr-case-from-home
cookies.purpose: Session storage. A one-time mark when you open a project from the homepage, so that visit is not counted twice. It holds only the project’s short name.
cookies.duration: Removed when read, or when the tab closes

privacy.cvBody: The CV is a plain PDF file served from this site. Downloading it sets no cookie. If you accepted analytics, the click is counted as a CV download, without any details about you.
privacy.changeBody: Use “Cookie settings” at the bottom of any page to change your choice at any time. Switching to Reject also removes the Google Analytics cookies.
privacy.emailBody: Your message is used only to reply and talk about the role or project. It is not added to a mailing list or shared with anyone.
privacy.contactBody: Email {email} about anything on this page.
